Name: The Hatter's Garden - Custom Farm Type
Author: hoshikuzunosora
Description:
My older sister told me that if I made her a farm she'd bake me a pan of brownies... boy am I excited for those LMAO

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]FEATURES!

[/b][/size][/color]- A completely custom farm type with custom furniture and starter gift (i had no idea what to do for the icon so it's just sis' favorite color)

- Forest Farm Forageables naturally spawn on the grass!

- Secret Rose Garden that functions as a greenhouse. Plant flowers or whatever else you want!

- A sectioned off space of land that prevents animals from wandering off and is filled with blue grass

- Space for 2 junimo huts and another small patch of land for extra flowers/plants

- Plenty of space to build whatever your heart desires!

I've tested this thoroughly for bugs but if you encounter an issue please let me know! If you have any suggestions or feedback also throw them my way!

Thank you for visiting my mod. I hope you have a nice day/night.
